title: Marketing Coordinator
description: We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator to plan and run social media and content campaigns for our brand in Phnom Penh. You will work with designers and the sales team, track campaign results, and keep our channels active and consistent.

title: Graphic Designer
description: We are hiring a Graphic Designer to create branding, print and digital designs. You will turn briefs into finished layouts, keep our visual identity consistent, and work closely with the marketing team.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: We need an Administrative Assistant to support daily office operations. Duties include scheduling meetings, managing documents and records, handling correspondence, and coordinating with staff and visitors.
